description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Two built-in renderers, MobileGlues and SimpleFPEWrapper, were added: a gear entry at the end of each built-in renderer row opens configuration for environment variables and the full set of MobileGlues runtime options (ANGLE, no-error mode, GLSL cache size, FSR1 upscaling, etc.), merged into the config at launch (#1971).
2. The 3D skin preview restored its voxelized solid second layer (replicating 3D Skin Layers): every fully opaque pixel of the second layer generates a textured cube with directional lighting, fixing the 3D skin layer toggle having almost no visible effect since 1.3.4.2.
3. The control editor gained cross-group capabilities: copying/moving a single control across groups, merging a group's controls into another group, editable reference groups for viewing and editing multiple groups at once, and binding a control group to show/hide with a specified state (show on press / hide on press), backward compatible with old configurations (#1763).
4. The OSMesa renderer was split out of the app into a renderer plugin (no longer bundled), and two native crashes of the VirGL plugin renderer were fixed (#1959).
5. Fixed the version list jumping abnormally when switching versions: tapping no longer drags the list up and down, refreshing no longer replays row slide/fade animations, and selecting an already-visible entry no longer yanks the viewport (#1974).
6. Fixed Cleanroom losing all vanilla sound: lwjgl-openal.jar was updated with a null check on alcDevice in AL.create(), and the jsound bridge now activates the context thread-locally so it no longer gets taken over by a second context (#1969, #1980).
7. Fixed a startup crash on 26.4 snapshots: JNA 5.19.1 natives were added to assets, with an automatic per-architecture download fallback from Maven Central when missing.
8. Fixed NoSuchFileException when downloading via BMCLAPI without an explicit checksum (e.g. OptiFine): the fallback hash is now computed incrementally with SHA-1 while writing.
9. Fixed occasional theme-background drawing crashes (Glide bitmap recycled by the pool), Actinium's title screen setting the window to 0×0, download-page items showing the underlying swipe favorite button when the theme color opacity is below 100%, and user agreement/privacy page links turning invisible when they match the background color.
10. Fixed MioLibPatcher's system report failing on three sections of information (missing utmpx symbol on bionic, now stubbed).

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.新增内置 MobileGlues 与 SimpleFPEWrapper 渲染器：内置渲染器列表行尾新增齿轮入口，支持配置环境变量与 MobileGlues 全量运行时选项（ANGLE、无错误模式、GLSL 缓存、FSR1 超分等），启动时合并写入生效 (#1971)
2.皮肤 3D 预览恢复体素化实心第二层（复刻 3D Skin Layers）：第二层每个不透明像素生成贴图立方体并带方向光照，修复 1.3.4.2 起 3D 皮肤层开关几乎无差别的问题
3.控件编辑跨组能力：支持单控件跨组复制/移动、控件组合并到其他组、参考组开放编辑实现多组同看同改、绑定控件组显隐可指定状态（按下显示/按下隐藏），旧配置向后兼容 (#1763)
4.OSMesa 渲染器从内置剥离为插件提供（不再随包内置），并修复 VirGL 插件渲染器两处 native 崩溃 (#1959)
5.修复版本列表切换版本时异常跳动：点按不再牵动列表上下窜动、刷新不再整行横滑闪烁、选中已可见条目不再拽动视口 (#1974)
6.修复 Cleanroom 原版音效全失：更新 lwjgl-openal.jar 补充 alcDevice 判空，jsound 桥接改走线程局部 context 激活，不再被第二个 context 抢占 (#1969 #1980)
7.修复 26.4 快照启动崩溃：JNA 5.19.1 natives 补齐进 assets，缺失时自动从 Maven Central 下载对应架构库兜底
8.修复 OptiFine 等无显式校验值的 BMCLAPI 下载报 NoSuchFileException：兜底哈希改为写入时增量 SHA-1 计算
9.修复主题背景偶发绘制崩溃（Glide 位图被池回收）、Actinium 标题界面把窗口设成 0×0、主题色透明度<100% 时下载页条目透出侧滑收藏按钮、用户协议/隐私页链接与背景同色隐形
10.修复 MioLibPatcher 系统信息三组信息报错（bionic 缺 utmpx 符号，符号桩兜底）
